contexts.text: Behold three baskets () = successive voluntary things (AC 5152)... Baskets = voluntary things. The reason baskets = voluntary things, is that they are vessels for holding meats.
Basket, here () is the same word [in the Hebrew] as in this chapter, and = the Voluntary, in which are the good things signified by bread, cakes, oil, etc. By the Voluntary is meant the containant...
A basket () also = the Voluntary as the containant...

At that time similar things, which were for worship, were carried in baskets, or baskets (as in )... because baskets, or baskets, represented the containants, and the things which were in them, the things contained.
By the baskets full of holes upon his head, is signified that the interiors were without any termination in the middle. Explained.
In the uppermost basket = the inmost of the Voluntary. A basket = the Voluntary.
A bird eating from the basket upon my head = that falsity from evil consumed... The basket = the Voluntary, here, what is evil from the Voluntary, because the basket was perforated.
There appeared two naked infants with baskets in their hands.
